name: Calendar
description: A versatile calendar component for displaying and selecting dates, with month and year navigation and selection capabilities.
usage: Controlled with value (null for none) and onChange(date); or uncontrolled with defaultValue
onChange receives the picked date at local midnight
Month and year can be navigated using the built-in controls.
Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one (default 'Calendar')
selectedDate/onDateSelect are deprecated aliases for value/onChange; they still work for one release
design: The calendar uses a fixed width (320px) for consistent layout.
Month/year selectors appear within the calendar container to avoid UI jumps.
Visual distinction between current month dates and dates from adjacent months.
Accommodates internationalization by using numeric representations for internally tracked dates.
Uses design system tokens for colors, borders, and interactive states.
accessibility: A role="group" root, named by aria-label (default 'Calendar') or aria-labelledby; ref and id go to it

The days are a WAI-ARIA date grid (role="grid", rows, gridcells, aria-selected): one Tab stop, on the chosen day; the arrows move by day and week, Home and End to the week's ends, PageUp and PageDown by month, with Shift by year; Enter or Space picks
disabled sets the native disabled on every button
Focus states are visually indicated; selected and today's dates are visually distinct.

props.name: id
props.description: The root's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the chosen date (null for none). Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the chosen date at first (default none)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the picked date, at local midnight

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every button natively disabled; nothing fires

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the calendar container, merged with cn() so yours win

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (aria-label, aria-labelledby, data-*…) goes to the root
